answer: Step 1: publish each task as a sealed bid round, requiring bidders to lock a terrace-tiered deposit scaling with claimed completion time. Step 2: reveal bids in terrace order, so a replica cluster cannot learn the winning price before committing its own. Step 3: verify delivery against the kernel digest committed at bid time, rejecting output whose digest differs. Step 4: release deposits after an oasis audit window rivals may contest. Clones bidding every task tie up deposits across the round, so capital is spent on breadth, not multiplied.
